hypothesis: The current field's rival-only continuous front-running pressure adds inter-horse information beyond each horse's frozen PACE-01 history.

transformation.eligible_runner: current-field row with at least one other runner having finite PACE-01 history

within_race_transform.meaning: continuous excess above the frozen PACE-01 percentile midpoint
within_race_transform.aggregate: sum over finite other-runner front excess
within_race_transform.missing: NaN when no finite opponent history exists

transformation.timestamp_semantics: current field composed only from PIT PACE-01 histories already available at target date

evaluation_policy.candidate_change: add exactly the one registered pace-pressure column
evaluation_policy.development_2024: closed until the rolling decision authorizes a milestone
